summary: Pattaya agency running scheduled minivan border runs to the Laos border at Mukdahan and offering ED visa service.

facts.label: Border run
facts.value: Minivan border runs to Mukdahan at the Laos border on Sundays and Wednesdays
facts.quote: We go to Mukdahan city at Laos border every Sun. & Wed.

facts.label: Deposit
facts.value: Minimum deposit of 5000 THB, balance paid in the van
facts.quote: Minimum deposit payment is 5000 THB and remaining pay on sitting in the van.

facts.label: Non-B in Laos
facts.value: Non-B visa applications in Laos for Indian and Chinese passport holders, 18 000 THB
facts.quote: You can apply for a NON-B visa in LAOS since August 1 st 2026. Price: 18 000 THB
